## [vv0.1.67](releases/tag/vv0.1.67) - 2024-11-20
<!-- bump-type:patch -->
### New Features

- basic support for text_display entity ([#230](/issues/230))
- make fullscreen button (F11) configurable in the keybinding panel [`85ece5b`](/commit/85ece5b4ebaa60ffb4721e3ee2189e7bec15e15c)
- auto save worlds in singleplayer every 2 seconds since crashes might happen. still possible to cancel this behavior via new setting or ?noSave=true [`c8c4e32`](/commit/c8c4e3267d6126f59ce6335edb8c02bb01aa930d)
- add setting for debugging to disable signs text rendering [`c8c4e32`](/commit/c8c4e3267d6126f59ce6335edb8c02bb01aa930d)
- implement experimental clipWorldBelowY setting for testing [`32931ef`](/commit/32931efef0b541998f77895ca5bc5b2e77b8db85)
- allow singleplayer mode to be triggered by 'sp=1' query parameter along with `singleplayer=1` [`c303a0e`](/commit/c303a0e0d581ced6481046754f5e8aad29a5dcb2)
### Bug Fixes

- some keybinding names were incorrectly parsed [`85ece5b`](/commit/85ece5b4ebaa60ffb4721e3ee2189e7bec15e15c)
- **ui**: better support formatted minecraft messages (handle packets in general way) [`0506d9d`](/commit/0506d9de4711c8a23adead6bdf1c007375d96828)
- preserve server selection after going back to the servers list (eg from edit modal) [`a0a2c62`](/commit/a0a2c628b40644111d4bb2d88e69881ae7865060)
- was not possible to remove saved MS account by clicking on the profile picture [`a0a2c62`](/commit/a0a2c628b40644111d4bb2d88e69881ae7865060)
- highlight active zone for interaction to avoid UI confusion [`a0a2c62`](/commit/a0a2c628b40644111d4bb2d88e69881ae7865060)
- save the proxy to memory immedieately after editing it in the servers list screen [`a0a2c62`](/commit/a0a2c628b40644111d4bb2d88e69881ae7865060)
- Error messages were not displayed after unsuccessful Microsoft auth. Fixed all error messages. [`d32f510`](/commit/d32f5107448ed3cd4536f2d2b463a314c949e80f)
